User pinged (WiFi toggle vs reboot; reboot loses the 12 swarm sessions but clears the 6-day airportd pin + synckitd crash loop). CORRECTION to the earlier "step 2 never upgraded anything": the box is PARTIALLY upgraded — cc-notes 0.47.10 ✓, reposync 0.27.4 ✓ (cask), synckitd likely 0.36.2 (cache purge of 0.35.2 tarball observed; unconfirmed), cc-patch likely 0.12.2 (linking observed; unconfirmed), cc-pool NOT (0.61.7, dual-keg debris intact, uninstall window never opened), captain-hook NOT (12.20.2). Nothing else mutated: no manifest/state/host-add/deletions; steps 3-6 never began. Holds from the sweep: 18 leaked daemonkit test processes killed (0 resurrected; evidence /tmp/daemonkit-test-leaks-1785025196.txt), PID 13886 correctly spared (cookie-sync dev process), 0.21.0 zombie image gone (handshake counter frozen at 20,471), 12 Claude sessions intact. Chunked resume staged lead-side: /tmp/dk-step2-chunked.sh (per-formula timeout chunks + .done markers, cc-pool uninstall/install as separate chunks) + step3/step4/resume-verify; only dk-step2.sh is on the box.

LOCAL — captain-hook surgery no-op ×3: brew reinstall's postinstall fails at helper bootstrap (EIO after 6 attempts, desired Aqua == current Aqua, so session MISMATCH ruled out; quarantine ruled out; label absent from every domain yet unregisterable). Deployed bundle pinned at 12.20.9 (Cellar 12.20.10), daemon pid 61736 untouched. Host is otherwise healthy — socket accepts, other sessions dispatch; the new-session hook failures are the capt-hook client's signed-host-ready gate tripping on the absent helper. SEPARATE live bug found in capt-hookd.log: a hook handler failing every few seconds with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wasmtime' (being identified + filed).

EIO ROOT-CAUSE STATE: two theories — per-label launchd DB wedge (doesn't explain home's fresh-label repro) vs categorical launchctl-bootstrap refusal of LimitLoadToSessionType-bearing plists (predicts all observations on both machines: victims carry the key with different values, healthy agents carry none, matched-Aqua still fails). Key-removal differential now in flight on BOTH machines; verdicts will name the root cause for the daemonkit P1 (staging-path sibling bug already filed: 74be91d7). Fleet-convergence implication if confirmed: helper delivery everywhere is gated behind a daemonkit-side fix → freeze-exception decision (targeted v0.20.7) goes to the user.
